description: Japanese-only synthesis engine behind the Aivis Cloud API; every public, unlisted or private AIVM voice model on AivisHub is served by it.

meta.custom_models: Style-Bert-VITS2 models converted with AIVM Generator can be uploaded and used via the API.
meta.model_selection: The API has no engine/model-id parameter: requests pass `model_uuid` (an AivisHub AIVM voice model UUID, or an `ak_` access key for unlisted models) plus optional `speaker_uuid` and `style_id`/`style_name`.
meta.streaming_note: Audio is streamed progressively in the HTTP response (chunked); no WebSocket endpoint.

name: Aivis Cloud API (Style-Bert-VITS2 JP-Extra)

pricing.notes: Pay-as-you-go prepaid credits: JPY 440 (tax incl.) per 10,000 characters; only the synthesis API is billed. New accounts get JPY 500 of free credit (about 11,000 characters). Aivis Premium subscription: JPY 1,980/month (tax incl.) for unlimited characters within a 10 requests/minute rate limit, combinable with pay-as-you-go overage.
